children: US royalty manager's Q2 collaboration revenue rose yr/yr, driven by higher Jemperli royalties
Net income from continuing operations surged, mainly due to a large tax benefit
As of June 30, company has not repurchased shares under its $100 mln buyback plan; litigation judgement expected Q4 2026 or Q1 2027
Company anticipates FDA approval of Jemperli in rectal cancer by February 2027
Anaptys expects FDA approval of Quimilza in GPP in December 2026
Company expects to achieve >$390 mln in annualized Jemperli royalties as early as 2029
JEMPERLI ROYALTIES - Higher Jemperli royalties drove collaboration revenue growth
TAX BENEFIT - Net income surged due to release of valuation allowance on deferred tax assets after company separation
LEGAL COSTS - Higher general and administrative expenses mainly due to legal costs for company separation and GSK/Tesaro litigation
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 11 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for AnaptysBio, Inc. is $85.50, about 54.9% above its September 18 closing price of $55.20
